subject.title: [Bug]: Plugin HTTP work bypasses Gateway suspension admission

question: Should the protected cooperative-suspension contract be completed now by tracking ordinary plugin HTTP and plugin-owned upgrade ingress, with only authenticated suspension control exempted?
rationale: The source bug and repair boundary are clear, but the maintainer label reserves this new, unreleased lifecycle contract and its auth-sensitive exemption for explicit maintainer ownership.

options.title: Complete plugin admission
options.body: Apply the existing root-work contract after plugin match and authentication, preserving only the authenticated suspension control path.

options.title: Keep host-managed plugin fencing
options.body: Leave plugin ingress outside readiness and revise the suspension contract and docs to require hosts to fence all plugin HTTP and upgrade traffic externally.

recommendation.title: Complete plugin admission
recommendation.body: Apply the existing root-work contract after plugin match and authentication, preserving only the authenticated suspension control path.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced both plugin HTTP routing and the adjacent cooperative suspension contract and is assigned to the issue.
